clips.title: The story
paras: Dark Iron attacks in the Wetlands have Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII fearing for the Stonewrought Dam. With much of its garrison sent to the Alliance Front, you investigate sappers near the eastern ramp.

The Stonewrought Dam holds back Loch Modan's waters, a great feat of Ironforge engineering. As conflicts spread across Khaz Modan and beyond, much of its security detail has been reassigned to the Alliance Front. Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII and his small remaining crew now face the threat of an attack with little protection.

Dark Iron attacks in the Wetlands have given Hinderweir reason to worry. The dwarves struck the Thandol Span and pillaged the fortress town of Dun Modr. Now known Dark Iron sappers lurk near the dam's eastern ramp. Hinderweir fears the clan has turned its attention to the lifeline of Loch Modan.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Thank the stars someone is concerned about the well-being of the Dam. First the destruction of the Thandol Span and then the pillaging of Dun Modr! I have no doubt that the Dam will be the target of the next Dark Iron threat. Most of the security detail here was reassigned to the Alliance Front, including my top inspector.
That's why I need you, friend. I spotted some Dark Iron Sappers milling about the eastern ramp of the Dam. Investigate the area and bring back a clue.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The suspicious looking barrel contains a strange smelling powder.
